title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity - roles, stop/logprobs, streaming, response formatting
author: Aisha Patel
description: Brings Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for /v1/chat.completions closer to parity with common OpenAI behaviors. This PR includes: role handling normalization, stop token pass-through, logprobs plumbing, improved streaming stability (chunking/backpressure and reconnect semantics), and response formatting hooks for structured outputs. Motivation: several customers and SDKs rely on OpenAI semantics (roles mapping, stop sequences, logprobs) and streaming behavior; mismatches caused integration bugs and flaky streaming clients. This change updates the compatibility layer, runtime plumbing, SDK adapters, and end-to-end tests.

b7e2c11: runtime: expose stop tokens to sampling pipeline; thread through to tokenizer
c3d5e9f: streaming: implement chunked framing and backpressure-aware writer; add reconnect support
d9f7b2a: openai-compat: wire logprobs param to scoring kernel and proto output

f2b8d44: tests: add e2e fixtures for roles/stop/logprobs/streaming; flake-tolerant streaming asserts
g8c0f55: docs: compatibility notes for chat.completions parity and examples

release_notes:
- OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity improvements: roles normalization and permissive forwarding
- Stop tokens: pass-through to sampling and tokenizer; supports multi-token stops
- logprobs: expose top-k logprobs in compat output when requested
- Streaming: improved chunk framing and backpressure handling; supports client-side resume token for reconnects
- SDK updates and new e2e tests for parity
